nodes.label: Polished Blackstone Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style polished blackstone texture. Very dark charcoal-black surface with a smooth, refined appearance and subtle lighter pixel flecks suggesting a polished stone finish. Slightly lighter than netherite block with a more uniform, refined look. Color palette: very dark grey-charcoal (#1C1C1C to #2C2C2C) with minor lighter noise pixels. Game purpose: decorative polished variant of blackstone; crafted by polishing blackstone blocks found in the Nether; used for dark, sleek architectural builds.
nodes.pattern: smooth uniform dark surface with minimal pixel noise suggesting polished finish
